# Copilot repository instructions

Follow the repository-wide guidance in `AGENTS.md` before making changes.

This is a standalone Next.js 16 App Router portfolio using React 19, TypeScript,
Tailwind CSS 4, and pnpm. Keep Server Components as the default, preserve the
existing editorial design and printable A4 résumé, use Next.js metadata and image
primitives, and do not invent backend services or environment variables.

Validate code changes with `pnpm check`. Also run `pnpm build` for changes that
can affect production rendering, routing, metadata, or compilation.
